title: The Body
tone: A walk through a sculpture gallery that turns into a dance: each work on a low plinth, one figure scale, the floor line continuous; by the end the plinths are gone and the figures move.

episodes.title: The Discus Thrower, c. 460 BC
episodes.scene: Myron catches the body at the instant before the throw.
episodes.keyImage: The thrower coiled on a plinth.

episodes.title: Winged Victory, c. 190 BC
episodes.scene: Victory lands on a ship's prow, wind in her dress.

episodes.title: Venus de Milo, c. 100 BC
episodes.scene: Stillness: the body at rest, arms lost.

episodes.title: Vitruvian Man, c. 1490
episodes.scene: Leonardo measures the body against the circle and the square.

episodes.title: David, 1504
episodes.scene: Michelangelo's David waits before the fight.
episodes.keyImage: David standing, weight on one leg.

episodes.title: Little Dancer Aged Fourteen, 1881
episodes.scene: Degas brings a real girl from the ballet into sculpture.

episodes.title: Dance, 1910
episodes.scene: Matisse's ring of dancers on a hill: the body freed.
